name: Christine Drazan
summary: Christine Renee Drazan (née  Deboy, born May 28, 1972) is an American politician who has served in the Oregon State Senate since 2025 in the 26th district as a member of the Republican Party. Prior to her tenure in the state senate she was a member of the Oregon House of Representatives from the 39th and 51st districts. She was minority leader in the state house from 2019 to 2021, and in 2025.
